name: BuffSkillHpHurt
description: HP-Based Damage buff — deals damage based on defender's max HP. This is the complex 'HP-Based Damage' system referenced in Yuko's guide.

onBegin.description: Executes when buff is applied — immediately deals HP-based damage
onBegin.condition: Only fires if NOT_HURT battle flag is not set

formula_steps.description: Get defender's max HP and attacker's general resistance

formula_steps.note: Uses the pierce/block system for resistance

formula_steps.description: Calculate base HP damage with resistance component
formula_steps.formula: damage = roundInt(maxHP * skillPar) + roundInt(maxHP * resistPar * resistValue)
formula_steps.note: skillPar = base HP% damage, resistPar = additional HP% scaled by resistance

formula_steps.description: Apply damage clamping if limit is defined

sub_steps.formula: ATK = attacker.att; DEF = defender.def; DEF_COE = defender.def_coe; att_dam = attacker.att_dam
minDmg = roundInt(refDmg * limit[0]); maxDmg = roundInt(refDmg * limit[1])

sub_steps.description: Clamp damage between min and max

formula_steps.note: Clamps HP-based damage relative to what a normal attack would do. Prevents it from being too weak or too strong.
Checks defender's skill effects for HP_Hurt triggers and fires them

simplified_formula.unclamped: damage = roundInt((roundInt(maxHP * skillPar) + roundInt(maxHP * resistPar * pierce_block(resist))) * injuryReduce)
simplified_formula.clamped: damage = clamp(unclamped, roundInt(normalDmg * limit[0]), roundInt(normalDmg * limit[1]))

key_notes: HP-based damage uses defender's MAX HP, not current HP
The resistance component uses the general 'resist' attribute (1021), not att_resist
Pierce/block mechanics apply to the resistance portion
Damage is clamped relative to normal attack damage when limit array is provided
This buff fires immediately on application (onBegin), not over time
